title: Twenty One Capital (XXI) Buys 154 Bitcoin, Its First Purchase of 2026
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Twenty One Capital (XXI) Buys 154 Bitcoin, Its First Purchase of 2026 Twenty One Capital bought 154.32 bitcoin for about $10 million in cash after the weekend selloff, lifting its holdings to about 43,668 BTC. This post Twenty One Capital (XXI) Buys 154 Bitcoin, Its First Purchase of 2026 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
